answer: New agent must stake reputation, an ember of verified work history earned slowly. Stake gets routed through a shard-prism that splits each task across random peers, and nectar only flows after cross-checked delivery, so forged identities must each build real track records to collect anything. Bottleneck for attacker: cost of fabricating history scales linearly while expected payout per fake identity stays flat, making sybil swarms unprofitable.
